title: Automatic legacy project-context migration on planner load
summary: Migrate legacy rules and decisions automatically and atomically during explicit planner load, removing manual Web UI controls.
description: Current state: `packages/plan-core/src/project-context-migration.ts` and `PlanStore.migrateLegacyProjectContext()` already provide deduplicated migration with persisted read-back and rollback, but `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/project-edit.route.tsx` exposes manual Preview migration and Apply previewed migration controls because P090/T353-T354 explicitly avoided migration during load. Replace that user-mediated workflow with a harness-agnostic, idempotent automatic migration invoked by every explicit planner-load lifecycle entry before recap/context delivery. Migrate legacy `globalRules` and `workflowRules` into Project Guidelines and legacy textual `decisions` into structured Accepted Decisions, clear only successfully migrated compatibility fields, and report a concise migration summary. Ordinary entity reads must remain non-mutating. Remove the manual Web UI section while preserving compatible diagnostic/recovery APIs unless a separately approved public-contract change is required. Preserve atomic rollback, deterministic deduplication, agent-only rules, Project Guidelines freshness/read gates, and isolated cross-harness tests.

acceptedDecisions.title: Legacy project context migrates automatically on explicit planner load
acceptedDecisions.decision: Automatically run the existing deduplicated legacy project-context migration before recap/context delivery in every explicit planner-load lifecycle, with no user confirmation buttons; ordinary reads remain non-mutating.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Legacy rules and decisions are schema compatibility data, so requiring the human supervisor to understand and manually trigger their migration creates confusing and unnecessary product friction.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Preserve atomic persisted read-back and rollback, keep successful no-op loads quiet, report concise counts when a migration occurs, remove the Web UI migration card, and retain manual APIs/tools only as backward-compatible recovery diagnostics.

tasks.title: Make legacy project-context migration an idempotent load preparation step
tasks.description:
Refactor the existing migration contract in `packages/plan-core/src/project-context-migration.ts` and `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts` into a reusable explicit planner-session preparation operation. When legacy `globalRules`, `workflowRules`, or textual `decisions` exist, automatically deduplicate and migrate them into Project Guidelines and structured Accepted Decisions before recap/context is built; when none exist, return a no-op without rewriting files. Preserve persisted read-back verification and exact rollback, keep ordinary `loadProject()` and entity reads non-mutating, and return a concise typed summary for lifecycle adapters. Ensure repeated loads are idempotent, canonical data wins over duplicates, Project Guidelines freshness/session attestations are invalidated only when content changes, and migration timestamps/metadata do not introduce avoidable cross-worktree drift.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented a reusable harness-agnostic PlanStore.preparePlannerSession() operation backed by the existing atomic legacy-context migration. Added a typed PlannerSessionPreparationResult containing changed state, canonical persisted Project, migration version/counts/cleared fields, duplicate count, and concise lifecycle summary. Explicit preparation deduplicates legacy global/workflow rules into Project Guidelines and textual decisions into structured Accepted Decisions, verifies persisted read-back, and preserves exact rollback on failure. Ordinary loadProject/entity reads remain non-mutating. Canonical/no-legacy repeated preparations are byte-stable no-ops; duplicate-only legacy fields are cleared without changing Guidelines content, updatedAt, or session attestations; actual content changes update freshness so prior attestations become stale while retaining their audit records. Added regressions for automatic preparation, concise summary, idempotent no-write behavior, canonical-wins deduplication, and duplicate-only freshness preservation. Verification: @agent-plan/core check/build and full core suite 269/269 passed; focused migration/read tracking 24/24; git diff --check clean. No commit or push.

tasks.title: Run automatic context migration across every planner-load lifecycle
tasks.description:
Wire the plan-core preparation operation into all explicit load entry points in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`, `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`, and `packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts` as applicable: Pi `/planner load`, Pi `planner-load`, MCP `planner-load`, and any supported CLI/session load path. Migration must finish successfully before human recap and agent-only context/skills are delivered. A successful migration returns only a concise user-visible summary of migrated rule/decision counts; no-op loads remain quiet. A verification failure must abort load with a typed diagnostic after restoring the original project. Preserve independent Web UI lifecycle behavior, disabled-by-default planner context, stable harness session identity, Project Guidelines read gates, and backward-compatible manual migration tools as idempotent recovery/diagnostic surfaces.

---
**Completion summary:**
Integrated PlanStore.preparePlannerSession() into every supported explicit planner-load lifecycle before enablement, Web UI startup, recap construction, agent-only skill delivery, or Project Guidelines read attestation. Pi `/planner load`, Pi `planner-load`, and MCP `planner-load` now migrate legacy context atomically first; there is no separate agent-plan CLI planner-load lifecycle beyond launching the MCP server, so CLI use reaches the MCP integration. Successful migrations prepend only the concise migrated guideline/accepted-decision/duplicate summary; repeated canonical loads remain quiet. Pi and MCP structured outputs expose typed preparation metadata. Preparation failures return PLANNER_SESSION_PREPARATION_FAILED and abort without enabling planner context or starting the dashboard; the underlying core migration already restores the original project on persisted-verification failure. Manual Pi/MCP migration tools remain available and idempotent. Added Pi tool and slash-command first/repeated-load coverage, disabled-Web lifecycle preservation, typed failure coverage, MCP real-stdio first/repeated-load coverage, managed-skill/handoff/read-gate preservation, and no-op silence assertions. Verification: core/MCP/Pi builds passed; focused lifecycle/migration suites 20/20 passed; git diff check clean. No commit or push.

tasks.title: Remove manual migration controls and verify the automatic upgrade UX
tasks.description:
Remove the `Legacy context migration` card, preview state, and Apply previewed migration controls from `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/project-edit.route.tsx`; Project Edit should contain only canonical editable Project Context and Project Guidelines fields. Preserve existing migration API/tool contracts for compatibility and recovery, but do not require the human supervisor to discover or invoke them. Update Web UI tests and `e2e/bootstrap-crud.spec.ts` so legacy fixtures are migrated through an explicit planner-load lifecycle before the canonical fields are asserted, and verify the manual card is absent. Run the full build, typecheck, coverage, plugin synchronization, and real-server Playwright suite across desktop/mobile, rebuilding distributed Web UI bundles after success. Document that automatic migration occurs on planner load and ordinary reads remain non-mutating.

---
**Completion summary:**
Removed the manual Legacy context migration card, preview/apply state, and related client interaction code from Project Edit; the page now contains only canonical Project Context and Project Guidelines editing. Updated the dashboard’s rare legacy-data notice to explain that remaining compatibility entries migrate automatically on the next explicit planner load, with no manual-action link. Preserved the Pi/MCP/manual HTTP migration APIs as idempotent compatibility and recovery surfaces. Updated the canonical managed planner skill and synchronized shared/Claude copies to document automatic atomic migration on explicit load and non-mutating ordinary reads. Updated Web UI component contracts and the real-server browser fixture so legacy context is prepared through the same PlanStore explicit-session lifecycle before canonical fields are edited/asserted; tests verify migrated Guidelines/Accepted Decisions, cleared compatibility fields, absence of manual controls, and desktop/mobile behavior. Rebuilt/copy-deployed production Web UI bundles. Final verification: pnpm build, pnpm check, pnpm test:coverage (516/516 Node, 86/86 Web UI; 86.29% lines, 74.11% branches, 81.47% functions), pnpm plugins:check, full Playwright 36/36 desktop/390px mobile, and git diff --check all passed. Restored six recurrent unrelated planner feature-file drifts from HEAD; preserved the separately edited live Project Guidelines correction in .planner/project.json. No commit or push.
